title: questtimerframe
summary: MSUI now implements current Benilla's separate timed-quest window: live server-clock subtraction with the byte-verified minus-one bias, failed/untimed/expired filtering, log-order rows, exact SecondsToTime spelling, 160px dialog and header art, 45 + 16*n height, twenty exact row seats with top-anchored GameFontHighlightSmall countdowns, default-ANCHOR_RIGHT classic white quest-title tooltips, click-to-open/select, and the managed quest-timer to durability to quest-watch stack. QuestTimerFrameUiLaw owns the frame, font identities, row screen rectangles, text anchors, and tooltip seat; the renderer contains no local Vector2 geometry or raw ImGui tooltip. Focused and full deterministic checks pass; a live timed quest and pixel comparison remain open.

openItems.text: Verify a live timed quest counts down, shows its white classic tooltip at the row's exact right anchor, opens the correct quest-log entry on click, disappears on expiry/failure, and moves the durability and quest-watch frames by its dynamic height at multiple UI scales.
QuestTimer countdown text was vertically centered within each 16px row, while the current template TOP-anchors its GameFontHighlightSmall FontString at the row top.
openItems.resolution: QuestTimerFrameUiLaw now owns the title/row font identities and converts the authored row-top anchor to GameText's center point using the measured em. Focused QuestTimer and full desktop clinical suites pass without changing Quest Log presentation or timer behavior.

openItems.text: QuestTimer rows used an implicit ImGui tooltip even though current Benilla calls GameTooltip:SetOwner(self) with its default ANCHOR_RIGHT and SetText white content.
openItems.resolution: QuestTimerFrameUiLaw now owns the exact tooltip BOTTOMLEFT-to-row-TOPRIGHT seat. The renderer publishes the quest title as a typed white SetText line through the shared classic GameTooltip adapter; focused QuestTimer and GameTooltip clinical checks pin the route and ban raw ImGui tooltip fallback.
